notes: Stories reviewed; no duplicates or gaps identified. Structure aligns with required breakdown.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define request/response schema for clinical trial search including condition, location (zip/city/state), recruiting status, and normalized response fields (trial_id, title, phase, locations, eligibility_summary, distance/time optional). Align with Pydantic models.

stories.title: Core ClinicalTrials.gov Search Logic
stories.description: Implement core service logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov API filtered to recruiting trials by condition and location, parse results, and normalize structured trial data including sites and eligibility summary.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Time Enrichment
stories.description: Enhance trial results with optional travel distance and duration using Google Routes API based on user location and trial site locations.

stories.title: Facade and Tool Routing Integration
stories.description: Integrate clinical trials search into EvaluateCare facade and expose via tool router for conversational access, ensuring validated inputs and structured outputs.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Search Testing and Integration
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering schema validation, API query behavior, result normalization, and travel enrichment, including edge cases (no results, invalid location, API failure).
stories.evidence: GAP: No dedicated clinical trials tests found; must be created following existing backend test patterns
